defects: CITATION_BYPASS: hasCitations() treats arrays containing only null/empty objects as valid (e.g., citations:[null], citation_ids:[null], citations:[{}]) — allows records with effectively no citations to pass eligibility
STABLE_ID_FORMAT_NOT_ENFORCED: eligible() accepts any string stable_id (e.g., 'not-a-web-id') without enforcing WEB-\d{3} or PKG/PANEL- patterns — allows malformed IDs into public export
PROVENANCE_VALIDATION_INCOMPLETE: eligible() only checks object(record.provenance) — accepts empty object {} or objects missing required source_file/source_line_start/source_line_end fields
CITATION_IDS_NULL_PASSES: citation_ids:[null] passes hasCitations() but provides no verifiable citation

SCHEMA_EXPORT_FORBIDDEN_DIVERGENCE: schema.js FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_KEYS (12 items, normalized key matching) differs from public-export.js FORBIDDEN regex (broader, includes 'source', 'line', 'review.*') — schema validation allows 'sourceFile' but export forbids it, creating inconsistent defense layers
CYCLIC_REFERENCE_DOS: assertSafe() uses unbounded recursion — cyclic references in report cause 'Maximum call stack size exceeded' instead of safe rejection

ARRAY_FORBIDDEN_IN_TEST_RECORDS: generatePublicExport strips forbidden fields via publicRecord allowlist, but assertSafe in writePublicExportOutputs only checks top-level report object — if forbidden fields somehow entered tests/packages arrays they would not be caught (though current publicRecord prevents this)
MANIFEST_FIELDS_NOT_VALIDATED: manifest_version and manifest_hash accepted as-is without format validation — could leak internal versioning or non-secret hashes
good_points: FAIL_CLOSED_DESIGN: publication_status defaults to BLOCKED; only records with ALL approvals, valid price, no conflicts/claims, citations, and proper provenance pass
ALLOWLIST_FIELD_SELECTION: publicRecord() uses explicit RECORD_FIELDS allowlist rather than denylist — only 9 permitted fields enter public output
DETERMINISTIC_SORTING: tests and packages sorted by stable_id; package test_ids sorted — identical input order produces identical output
COMPREHENSIVE_FORBIDDEN_REGEX: FORBIDDEN regex in public-export.js catches 15+ sensitive field patterns case-insensitively including nested variants
PRICE_VALIDATION_STRICT: approvedPrice() validates finite non-negative numbers, min<=max, rejects inverted ranges, and requires explicit approval flags
LEDGER_ALL_ROLES_REQUIRED: approvedLedger() requires ALL 6 review roles to have decision='approved' — no partial approval bypass
PACKAGE_MEMBER_VALIDATION: packages require test_ids to exist in approved tests, deduplicated, count-matched, and package itself approved
NO_WEBSITE_OUTPUT: writePublicExportOutputs only writes public-export.json/.md — explicitly asserts website.json absent
TEST_COVERAGE_EXCELLENT: 35 tests cover blocked states, forbidden stripping, deterministic sorting, package validation, empty exports, manifest passthrough
verdict: CONDITIONAL_PASS — strong fail-closed architecture with allowlist projection, but 8 defects (3 HIGH: citation/ID/provenance bypasses; 5 MEDIUM: schema divergence, cyclic DoS, manifest validation gaps). Fix citation/ID/provenance validation before production use.
recommended_tests: Test citations:[null] and citation_ids:[null] are BLOCKED (currently LEAKED)
Test stable_id format enforcement: reject non-WEB/PKG/PANEL patterns
Test provenance requires source_file, source_line_start, source_line_end
Test cyclic reference in report throws clean error (not stack overflow)
Test manifest_version/manifest_hash format validation (semver, SHA-256 hex)
Test schema.js and public-export.js FORBIDDEN sets align — add sourceFile/originalText/lineRange to schema FORBIDDEN_PUBLIC_KEYS
Test price field precedence: approved_customer_price > customer_price > public_price with approval flags
Test package with member referencing test not in input tests array is BLOCKED
